A ''Star Wars'' CCG '''turn''' is six consecutive '''phases''' executed by one player: activate, control, deploy, battle, move and draw.<ref name="gl20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]]</ref> Doing things in each phase is optional. The Dark Side player takes the first turn; the Light Side player then takes a turn, and play alternates until one player wins.<ref name="rb20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Rulebook, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0]]</ref> Cards frequently override these rules, and specific rules override general ones.<ref name="rb20" />

== Activate phase ==
The player counts their Force icons on all locations on table and adds 1 for personal Force. They may activate up to that many cards, moving them one at a time and face down from the top of the [[Life Force#Reserve Deck|Reserve Deck]] to the [[Life Force#Force Pile|Force Pile]].<ref name="rb20" />

== Control phase ==
A player controls a location when they have total ability of 1 or more there and the opponent does not. At each controlled location the player may initiate a [[Force drain]] equal to the opponent's Force icons there.<ref name="rb20" />

== Deploy phase ==
Characters, vehicles, starships and other cards enter play ("deploy") from hand by using Force equal to their deploy cost. Locations have no deploy cost. Characters, vehicles and starships deploy where the player has Force icons or presence.<ref name="rb20" />

== Battle phase ==
The player may use 1 Force to initiate a [[battle]] at each location where both players have total ability of 1 or more, but not more than once per turn at the same location. A battle has three segments: weapons, power and damage.<ref name="rb20" />

== Move phase ==
Characters, vehicles and starships may move from location to location, using landspeed, shuttling, docking bay transit, hyperspeed, landing and taking off, and embarking and disembarking.<ref name="rb20" />

== Draw phase ==
The player may draw any number of cards from the Force Pile into hand, one at a time. There is no hand-size limit. Cards left in the Force Pile stay available for the opponent's turn.<ref name="rb20" />

== End of turn ==
The player announces the end of the turn. Both players then re-circulate their [[Life Force#Used Pile|Used Piles]] by placing them beneath their Reserve Decks.<ref name="rb20" />
